events.title: DEMO Coming Soon!
events.summary: I am hard at work finishing this vertical slice for players to enjoy, you'll get a taste of the narrative and a solid 30 minutes of first person found footage gameplay and puzzle solving! The demo is coming soon, and it will be an early chance to experience the unsettling exploration and gameplay in The Red Window. Thank you to anyone who has wish listed so far, I am excited to deliver a quality horror experience to the indie horror community.
